# v0.10.1 · 目录生成与预览体验优化 / Outline Generation and Preview Improvements

## 中文

### 技术方案生成

- 精简目录生成请求，改进生成结果的格式校验、修复和回退流程，减少因格式问题反复重试的等待。
- 为目录生成任务增加暂停、继续和停止操作；重置目录时同步处理仍在运行的后台任务。
- 优化配图策略，支持按小节配图；移除 HTML 配图中依赖章节位置的编号。
- 在预览界面直接渲染 Mermaid 图，改善项目协作等场景的阅读体验。

### 配置与界面

- 修正商汤日日新文本模型和生图模型的配置与请求处理。
- 调整设置页、项目协作和软著页面的布局与文字对比度，提高可读性和操作便利性。

## English

### Technical plan generation

- Reduced outline generation input and improved validation, repair, and fallback for malformed responses to cut down repeated retries.
- Added pause, resume, and stop controls for outline tasks, and aligned reset with the running background task.
- Improved illustration selection, added per-section illustration control, and removed position-dependent numbering from HTML illustrations.
- Rendered Mermaid diagrams directly in previews, including project collaboration views.

### Configuration and interface

- Fixed SenseNova text and image model configuration and request handling.
- Refined layouts and text contrast in Settings, project collaboration, and software copyright screens.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/liwg1995/YuduBid/compare/v0.10.0...v0.10.1
